```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
library(data.table)

```

```{r}

patient_data2 <- read_csv("SP-Data_2026-10-17_175303.csv", locale = locale(encoding = "ISO-8859-1"))
```

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
#patient call and transport volume is empty
patient_data2 <- patient_data2|>
  select(-(29:32))|>
  mutate(
    date = mdy_hms(`Incident Date Time`),
    `mm/yyyy` = format(date, "%m/%Y"),
    month = my(`mm/yyyy`),
    season = case_when(
      month(date) %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ (year(date) - 2021) * 4 + 1,
      month(date) %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ (year(date) - 2021) * 4 + 2,
      month(date) %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ (year(date) - 2021) * 4 + 3,
      month(date) %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ (year(date) - 2021) * 4 + 4
    ),
    season_label = case_when(
      month(date) %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ paste("Winter", year(date)),
      month(date) %in% c(3, 4, 5) ~ paste("Spring", year(date)),
      month(date) %in% c(6, 7, 8) ~ paste("Summer", year(date)),
      month(date) %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ paste("Fall", year(date))
    )
  )

#want to count the patients' number of calls
patient_data2|>
  filter(!is.na(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`))|>
  count(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`, name = "num")|>
  count(`num`, name = "num_patients")|>
  view()

patient_data2|>
  filter(!is.na(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`))|>
  count(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`, name = "num")|>
  ggplot(aes(x = num))+
  geom_histogram()

##Most visits from a patient: 33
## 632 have visited more than once

#seeing how many calls for every patient and viewing only the patients
#who have visited more than once
patient_data2|>
  filter(!is.na(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`))|>
  group_by(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`)|>
  mutate(num_calls = n())|>
  ungroup()|>
  filter(num_calls > 1)|>
  view()

#Time in between patient calls
patient_time_data2 <- patient_data2|>
  filter(!is.na(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`))|>
  group_by(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`)|>
  arrange(`date`, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(num_calls = n(),
         returned = if_else(num_calls > 1, "returned", "did not return"),
         prev_visit = lag(date),
         time_between_visits_days = floor(difftime(date,
                                        prev_visit,
                                        units = "days")),
         time_between_visits_hrs = floor(difftime(date,
                                        prev_visit,
                                        units = "hours")))|>
  ungroup()

#Histogram of time between patient return, given that a patient has returned
patient_time_data2 |>
  filter(!is.na(time_between_visits_days))|>
  ggplot(aes(x = time_between_visits_days))+
  geom_histogram()+
  labs(title = "Histogram of time between patient return, given that a patient has returned")


#Now by dispatch reason
patient_time_data2 |>
  filter(!is.na(time_between_visits_days))|>
  ggplot(aes(x = time_between_visits_days))+
  geom_histogram()+
  facet_wrap(~`Dispatch Reason (eDispatch.01)`)

patient_time_data2 |>
  mutate(within_24_hrs = if_else(
    time_between_visits_days <= 1, "Within 24 hrs", "over 24 hrs"
  ))|>
  ggplot(aes(x = `Dispatch Reason (eDispatch.01)`, 
             fill = factor(within_24_hrs)))+
  geom_bar(position = "stack")+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = \(x) stringr::str_trunc(x, width = 15))+
  theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(
    angle = 45,
    hjust = 1))+
  labs(
    title = "Return Status by Reason",
    x = "Dispatch Reason",
    y = "Number of calls",
    fill = "Time between visits"
  ) 

patient_time_data2 |>
  mutate(within_24_hrs = if_else(
    (time_between_visits_days <= 1), "Within 24 hrs", "over 24 hrs"
  ))|>
  ggplot(aes(x = `Dispatch Reason (eDispatch.01)`, 
             fill = factor(within_24_hrs)))+
  geom_bar(position = "fill")+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = \(x) stringr::str_trunc(x, width = 15))+
  theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(
    angle = 45,
    hjust = 1))+
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of Return Status by Reason",
    x = "Dispatch Reason",
    y = "Proportion of calls",
    fill = "Time between visits"
  ) 

#it looks like most calls that are returning happen within an hour of the first call... why?
#It looks like that's because the different primary complaints
#duplicated the same events. So I got rid of that.

age_group_data <- patient_time_data2 |>
  filter(!is.na(`Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)`))|>
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      is.na(`Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)`) ~ NA_character_,
      `Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)` >= 100 ~ "99+",
      `Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)` >= 90  ~ "90-99",
      `Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)` >= 80  ~ "80-89",
      `Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)` >= 70  ~ "70-79",
      `Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)` >= 60  ~ "60-69",
      `Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)` >= 50  ~ "50-59",
      `Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)` >= 40  ~ "40-49",
      `Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)` >= 30  ~ "30-39",
      `Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)` >= 20  ~ "20-29",
      `Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)` >= 10  ~ "10-19",
      `Patient Age In Years (ePatient.15)` >= 0   ~ "0-9",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

return_summary <- age_group_data |>
  group_by(age_group, `Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`) |>
  summarize(
    returned = any(returned == "returned"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(age_group) |>
  summarize(
    n_patients = n(),
    prop_returners = mean(returned),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

time_summary <- age_group_data |>
  group_by(age_group)|>
    summarize(
      n = n(),
      mean = mean(time_between_visits_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      max = max(time_between_visits_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      median = median(time_between_visits_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      min = min(time_between_visits_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

age_group_summary <- time_summary |>
  left_join(return_summary, by = "age_group")

#how many returners return for the same reason? By reason
patient_time_data2 |>
  filter(!is.na(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`))|>
  group_by(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`)|>
  arrange(`date`, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(same_as_last = if_else(
    `Dispatch Reason (eDispatch.01)` == lag(`Dispatch Reason (eDispatch.01)`), 1, 0,
    missing = NA_real_))|>
  filter(!is.na(same_as_last))|>
  ggplot(aes(x = "All calls",
         fill = factor(same_as_last))) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill")+
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_discrete(
    name = "Dispatch reason",
    labels = c("0" = "Different from previous", "1" = "Same as previous")
  ) +
  labs(title = "Propotion of Returners Returning for the same reason, by reason",
  x = NULL, y = "Proportion of calls") +
  theme_minimal()+
  facet_wrap(~`Dispatch Reason (eDispatch.01)`)

#A little over 25% of returning patients return for the same reason

#Do returning patients have the same illness at a different rate based on how quickly they return?
patient_time_data2 |>
  filter(!is.na(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`))|>
  group_by(`Patient EMS Patient ID (ePatient.01)`)|>
  arrange(`date`, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(same_as_last = if_else(
    `Dispatch Reason (eDispatch.01)` == lag(`Dispatch Reason (eDispatch.01)`), 1, 0,
    missing = NA_real_))|>
  ungroup()|>
  mutate(within_24_hrs = if_else(
    (time_between_visits_days <= 1), "Within 24 hrs", "over 24 hrs"
  ))|>
  filter(!is.na(same_as_last))|>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(within_24_hrs), 
         fill = factor(same_as_last))) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  geom_text(
    stat = "count",
    aes(label = after_stat(count)),
    position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5),
    color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Propotion of Returners Returning for the same reason, by time since return and reason")+
  facet_wrap(~`Dispatch Reason (eDispatch.01)`)


returned_within_24 <- patient_time_data2 |>
  filter(returned == "returned")|>
  mutate(within_24_hrs = if_else(
    (time_between_visits_hrs <= 24), "Within 24 hrs", "over 24 hrs",
    missing = "Didn't return"))

returned_within_week <- patient_time_data2 |>
  mutate(within_week = if_else(
    (time_between_visits_days <= 7), "Within a Week", "over a Week",
    missing = "Didn't return"))
```
